title: Building a Portfolio—and the System That Keeps It Evolving

descriptions.short: A working portfolio, content system, and multi-AI workflow built to evolve without losing design intent.
descriptions.detail: What began as an AI-generated interface became a spatial Next.js portfolio, a project–tag content architecture, a bounded diff-sync workflow, and a Portfolio Operating System that keeps visual prototypes, production code, assets, versions, and AI collaborators aligned.
